verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own desktop and features pages directly claim users can 'experience Ubuntu with different choices of default desktop environment, applications and settings, backed by the full Ubuntu archive,' which matches the story of official variants with different DEs and default apps. A community user also refers to running 'Ubuntu GNOME' as a distinct variant. missing for 10: named list of the official variants and their desktops/default apps, documentation on obtaining or installing a specific variant, independent hands-on corroboration of choosing among them.
